# Evidence-Backed Talent Profile

Capability ID: talent-evidence-profile-machine-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a95d4f7e0df3e09c9b42996/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- evaluate this candidate from the evidence
- build a talent profile from this portfolio
- what roles fit this person's demonstrated skills
- find gaps in this candidate's proof
- turn this athlete or creator evidence into an opportunity dossier
- map this person's capabilities to opportunities

## Problem

A person, team or representative wants a structured view of demonstrated capabilities, missing proof, development questions and plausible opportunity classes without opaque personality scoring or sensitive-trait inference.

## Inputs

Person/prospect identifier, domain and supplied/authorized evidence; optional target opportunity and consent grant for nonpublic material.

## Outputs

Strengths, weaknesses, patterns, skills, development questions, evidence confidence, inference limits, opportunity bridge and missing proof.

## Pricing

No approved machine price/payment path was verified. Do not auto-quote.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: public machine discovery docs plus central Evercraft MCP matching. Commercial execution remains verification-gated; no automatic checkout or payment obligation.

No contact, representation, application or third-party sharing without explicit authority/consent. Analysis must not infer protected traits or use gated sensitive data for scoring.

Payment authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path for this capability.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
